Committee: Transportation and Energy
Sponsor: Allen
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/08/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 113 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons that violate the prohibitions related to electric bicycles provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Gerald H. Allen, Chair Person
Transportation and Energy
